# construction-iso-19650-mcp

> ISO 19650 / UK BIM Level 2 compliance for construction projects. EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP, and CDE structure validation.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_bim_maturity
- validate_eir
- validate_bep
- check_cde_structure
- list_iso_19650_clauses

## Install
```
pip install construction-iso-19650-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/construction-iso-19650-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
